default.verdict: 2026 causal attribution and dangerous oxygen depletion remain UNVERIFIED
default.sensitivity_caution: Jansen total-order estimates conditional on independent uniform inputs, chosen ranges and this simplified model. Not percentages, need not sum to one; finite-sample estimates can exceed one. Bootstrap intervals (200 paired row resamples) reflect Monte Carlo estimator variability only, not physical/model uncertainty. No event-specific information-gain result.
default.observation_comparison: Simulated instantaneous paths/minima cannot be validated against daily station means. A wide assumed-input envelope or overlap is not causal evidence or validation.
missing: Wetland outlet discharge and hydraulic connection
Upstream and outlet DO/DOC at subdaily resolution
assumptions: Simultaneous inundation at day zero; no growth or antecedent litter accumulation
Fixed-volume mixed floodplain and river boxes; identical assumed upstream oxygen for both
Constant input temperature and hydrology; no travel-time routing, algae, sediment demand or stratification
All released DOC treated as biodegradable on the sampled decay timescale: a strong structural assumption
Oxygen-limited carbon oxidation stops when oxygen is exhausted; remaining carbon retained
Potential stoichiometric demand is not actual depletion; downstream dilution and replenishment matter
No radar threshold-to-area conversion or field-gauge-to-depth conversion
